meta.note: Local (private) CAID action-type definitions pinned by this example, using the normative type entry schema from caid/DESIGN.md section 3. These types are NOT registered in caid/registry/action-types.json and carry no trust semantics: a CAID commits an identifier to canonical typed content, nothing more.

types.summary: One full-population cash tie-out procedure over named general-ledger cash accounts against bank statements at a stated period end.

required_fields.name: population_digest
required_fields.notes: sha256:<lowercase hex> over the canonical reconciling-item population the procedure must test in full

types.digest_notes: The population digest pins the exact full population; substituting, dropping, or adding an item changes the CAID.

types.summary: Human disposition of one named exception raised by one identified procedure execution.

required_fields.name: procedure_caid
required_fields.notes: the CAID of the procedure whose exception is being dispositioned; the join field

types.digest_notes: Dispositioning is a distinct consequential action with its own identity; it never rewrites the procedure result it refers to.
